Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.integration.dcat

package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.integration.dcat
Integration connectors that exchange descriptions of data assets using the W3C Data Catalog Vocabulary (DCAT). The receivers publish DCAT documents from file directories and event topics to the integration daemon's DCAT listeners; the cataloguer turns each document into data set, distribution and data service assets; and the publisher writes the DCAT descriptions of the assets in a publishing catalog to the file system.
